description: This file defines several Orleans grain interfaces related to stream lifecycle management, including consumer and producer grains, along with extension methods to facilitate stream ID creation and interaction.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerGrainExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IStreamLifecycleConsumerGrain, IFilteredStreamConsumerGrain, and IStreamLifecycleProducerGrain to facilitate stream ID creation and method invocation with GUIDs and namespaces.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Converts GUID and namespace to StreamId and invokes the grain's BecomeConsumer method.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Creates StreamId from GUID and namespace, then calls the corresponding test method.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Creates StreamId and calls the RemoveConsumer method on the grain.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Extension for IFilteredStreamConsumerGrain to become a consumer with additional sendEvensOnly flag.

methods.name: SubscribeWithBadFunc
methods.description: Extension method to subscribe with a potentially bad function, passing the StreamId.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Converts stream identifiers to StreamId and calls the grain's BecomeProducer method.
